name: Neck Rolls
description: Gentle mobility work for neck and upper back.
steps: Sit or stand tall with shoulders relaxed.
Slowly roll your head in a small circle.
Reverse direction and keep the movement controlled.

name: Brisk March In Place
description: Low-impact cardio for quick energy and circulation.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
March in place while driving knees upward.
Swing your arms naturally and keep a steady pace.

name: Box Breathing
description: Breathing drill to reduce stress and support recovery.
steps: Inhale through the nose for four counts.
Hold the breath for four counts.
Exhale slowly for four counts, then hold for four counts.
